why: This is a named, study-specific dataset rather than a reusable instructional element; its question taxonomy and classification models do not constitute instruction themselves.
name: Dataset of 434 expert-labelled authentic learner questions augmented to balance class distributions
product_description: A dataset created by Lee et al. containing 434 expert-labelled and class-balanced authentic questions from higher-education information technology students for training and evaluating models that classify inquiry depth.
